description: Expected results for the CRHM 'Bad Lake' official regression project. Inputs (badlake.prj + Badlake73_76.obs) are the unmodified files from the CRHMcode distribution's system_regression_test suite. The expected values here were recorded from a clean run of the INSTALLED crhm build (v4.7_16) and are deterministic (two runs produced an identical 42,557,139-byte output).

output.note: sha256/bytes are the exact fingerprint of the installed build's output; compared informationally (a rebuilt engine may drift slightly).

distribution_expected_mismatch.detail: Same 26282 lines, same timestamps and column header, but ~26250 data rows differ numerically. The shipped expected_output was generated by a different CRHM build than the installed v4.7_16. This baseline therefore pins the INSTALLED engine (reproducible), not the distribution file. Not treated as a pass/fail against the shipped file.
